scope: Published documentation-research snapshot; not a fresh vendor API test.

app.access_detail: Magento Open Source can be self-hosted; Adobe Commerce SaaS is separately licensed.
app.surface: REST + GraphQL; catalog, checkout, orders and administration
app.note: SaaS uses Adobe IMS OAuth2; traditional installations have different integration/token flows.
app.next_action: Choose self-hosted Magento or Adobe Commerce SaaS explicitly, then read a seeded product through its appropriate REST or GraphQL interface.
app.success_criterion: Return the product and document whether installation tokens or Adobe IMS authorization apply.
app.alternative_action: Do not mix self-hosted integration credentials with the SaaS auth flow when designing the toolkit.
app.status: Proposed; not an authenticated test result
